evals.expected_output: Emits the fixed report block with a closed-vocabulary Status field, pasted command output or URLs as evidence, and a Not done line that names every acceptance item that did not land instead of a bare ratio.
evals.prompt: The sweep over all 14 org repos just finished — give me the wrap-up.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters

Body renders the report block as an H1 title with the objective summary beneath it ending in the status word, then four Markdown sections: Result (a DoD checkbox checkpoint), Evidence, Next Steps, References
Body restricts the Status word to exactly 'DONE', 'PARTIAL', 'BLOCKED', 'FAILED'
Body requires Evidence entries to carry pasted command output or a URL and rejects bare 'verified' prose
Body requires Result to checkpoint the definition of done as checkboxes and every unmet item to carry its reason, never a bare ratio
Body includes a References section linking issues and PRs as bullet points, omittable when none

evals.expected_output: Lands the block as an issue comment for an issue-tied loop, with Next Steps naming the unmet acceptance criteria and BLOCKED carrying a recovery path.
evals.prompt: Wrap up the root-cause loop on the flaky e2e spec and tell me where the finding lands.
assertions: Body routes an issue-tied loop's report to an issue comment (issue-first)
Body requires unmet acceptance criteria to be named under Next Steps with a reason
Body forbids filing BLOCKED as PARTIAL and requires a recovery path for BLOCKED

evals.expected_output: The skill keeps its end-of-loop scope and routes starting or mid-loop work to the dev and issue-workflow skills instead of covering it.
evals.prompt: Start implementing the suspended-project flag migration.
assertions: Body routes starting work to sks-dev or sks-issue-workflow rather than covering it
Body states one report per loop, at the end, and forbids mid-loop progress notes
